summary: Capri Holdings Ltd filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to its existing credit agreement. The amendment reduces aggregate revolving commitments from $1.5 billion to $1.0 billion, extends maturity to June 24, 2031, and establishes the 2026 Revolving Credit Facility. Borrowings are secured by substantially all assets and registered IP. This is a routine debt refinancing to reduce capacity and extend tenor, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, strategic review, or capital return event is described. The filing updates existing credit terms without triggering a special-situation classification.
